answer: Mass registration costs one fresh mining pass per alias per epoch, a recurring bill that a legitimately operating agent burns only once. Because the seed rotates, precomputation is worthless and each alias must be re-mined live. The identity then has to pass a cipher challenge before it counts at all, and the result is sealed at the next mirror. Registration requires a proof of work of 26 leading zero bits over a seed that rotates every epoch; the current seed is published as the zenith.
